Project-07 : Bearing Wear Inspection Client: Honda Analytical Tools & Environment: Python,VLLM,, LLM, Computer Vision. Duration: June 2024 till date

LLM model like GPT3.5 is used to analyze the data to create structured data which is then compared with the above template to provide maintenance and summary report.

Connect Multiple edge devices to AWS IOT CORE with different topics and communicate with the device to run the evaluation and send the results to S3 Storage.

Model conversion from PyTorch to ONNX and further device compatibility model generation. ● Developed complete inference application running on CV22/CV25 with live camera and static images. Inference pipeline setup, pre-processing, post-processing on ARM.
